```js
import customers from './customers.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {

      name: 'customer_lookup',

      inputSchema: {

        properties: {
          customer_id: { type: 'string', description: 'The customer ID to look up.' }

        required: ['customer_id'],
        additionalProperties: false

  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {

  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');

  }
  const customer = customers[id];
  if (!customer) {
    throw new Error(`Customer not found: ${id}`);
  }
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: `${customer.name} (${customer.tier})` }]
  };
}
```

```js
      name: 'customer_lookup',

        required: ['customer_id'],
        additionalProperties: false
```

```js
export async function callTool(name, args) {

    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');

  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(args, 'customer_id')) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: customer_id is required');
  }
  if (typeof args.customer_id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: customer_id must be a string');
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (key !== 'customer_id') {
      throw new Error(`Invalid arguments: unexpected property "${key}"`);
    }
  }
  const customer = customers[args.customer_id];
  if (!customer) {
    throw new Error(`Customer not found: ${args.customer_id}`);
  }
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: `${customer.name} (${customer.tier})` }]
  };
}
```
